en: Heal

Recovers the HP of all allies, and heals all status
ailments. (Aura/Prayer)
Lightning Cleave

Causes special damage [Light] to all enemies near
the target. Inflicts more damage when striking a
weakness. (Cleave/Lightning II)
Synchronize

Casts Sync on all allies. For all allies, each stat
becomes the same as that of the ally with the
highest value. (Battlecry/Cheer)
X-Strike

Causes physical damage [Null] to all enemies near
the target. Inflicts more damage the sooner the
two strikes cross. (Cyclone/Charge)
Overdrive

Casts Double Action on a single ally, causing
effects to be generated twice when Momentum
mode is used. (Quick/Flawless Blow)
Phasal Shift

Causes special damage [Null] to all enemies near
the target. Also raises the SP gauges of all allies.
(Realization/All Creation)
Cross Cutter

Energy blades leave behind a cross that causes
physical damage [Null] to all enemies.
(Blade Wave/Wind Slash)
Blowbeat

Causes physical damage [Null] to all enemies.
Can also inflict Paralysis, Confusion, and Stun.
(Shock/Provoke)
Hagakure

Causes physical damage [Null] to all enemies near
the target, ignoring 30% of Defense. Also has a
high critical hit rate. (Spark/Diffuse)
Drain Slash

Causes special damage [Null] to all enemies near
the target. All allies absorb 40% of inflicted
damage as HP. (Radiance/Drain)
Fire Cleave

Causes special damage [Fire] to all enemies near
the target. Inflicts more damage when striking a
weakness. (Cleave/Fire II)

Countless meteors fall from the sky, causing
magical damage [Null] that ignores 50% of Defense
to all enemies. (Meteo/Booster)

Deploys a wall of absolute ice around all allies
that provides powerful defense against physical
attacks. (Wall/Enfrost)
Ice Cleave

Causes special damage [Water] to all enemies near
the target. Inflicts more damage when striking a
weakness. (Cleave/Ice II)

Interweaves meteors and jump attacks, causing
special damage [Null/2 hits] that ignores 50%

Causes physical damage [Null] to all enemies near
the target. Critical hits will cause increased
damage. (Backslash/Hellfire)

Reduces resistance against all elements for all
enemies, and boosts resistance against all
elements for all allies. (Magen/Snatch)

A high-speed, flawlessly interwoven attack that

enemies near the target. (Whirling Shot/Haste)

the target. Can also reduce ATB speed and status

knocked out. (Life II/Permanence)

elements. (Lightning/Pinpoint)

Awakens dormant life force and spiritual power,

Creates a helix of flames that cause special damage

(Whirling Shot/Enflame)

Creates a huge explosion like those triggered when
stars meet their demise, causing special damage
[Light+Fire] to all enemies. (Luminaire/Flare)

Causes physical damage [Null] to all enemies near
the target, ignoring 40% of Defense. Also has a
high critical hit rate. (Incite/Icicle Lance)

Invokes powerful blessings and healing power,
recovering the HP of all allies, and healing any
status ailments. (Cure II/Chakra)

damage caused. (Luminaire/Meteor Thrust)

Causes physical damage [Null] to all enemies near

Causes physical damage [Null] to all enemies near

enemies near the target. (Haste/Blunt Blow)

Causes physical damage [Null] to all enemies near

changes with each hit. (Oblivion/Jump)

near the target. (Haste/Cursed Slash)

Causes magical damage [Shadow+Time] to all

Causes physical damage [Special/10 hits] to all

Causes physical damage [Null] to all enemies near
the target. Can also reduce status resistance.
(Stone Slash/Bio)

Deploys a wall around all allies that nullifies all
magical attacks. (Demonic Strike/Barrier)

Creates an all-consuming explosion that causes

Causes special damage [Water/5 hits] to all
enemies. Can also inflict Freeze. (Emission/Ice II)

A pincer attack that seizes a tiny opening, causing

target. (Pinpoint/Precise Thrust)

Allows dormant power to be awoken at any time

(Condense/Serenity)

Causes physical damage [Null] to all enemies. Can

Causes physical damage [Null] to all enemies near
the target. The more damage has been received,
the more damage is inflicted. (Counter/Stalker)

the target. Absorbs 30% of inflicted damage as

everything to ash, causing magical damage [Fire+

Boosts the ATB speed of all allies. In exchange, the

Righteous Indignation

Causes physical damage [Null/2 hits] to all
enemies near the target. Increased critical hit

Shadow Moon

Causes special damage [Shadow] to all enemies
near the target. Inflicts more damage when
striking a weakness. (Royal Lance/Dark Matter)
